data.summary: The figures match Amazon's reported FY2023 and FY2022 results: revenue $574.8B vs $514.0B (+11.8%), gross profit $270.0B vs $225.2B (47.0% margin), operating income $36.9B vs $12.2B (6.4% margin), net income $30.4B vs a $2.7B loss, and diluted EPS $2.90 vs -$0.27. The calculations are correct, and gross profit did grow faster than revenue (~19.9%).
